title: Fireboy & Watergirl in The Forest Temple
alternateTitles: Fireboy and Watergirl in The Forest Temple
Fireboy and Watergirl: The Forest Temple
Fireboy & Watergirl 1 in The Forest Temple
Fireboy and Watergirl 1 in The Forest Temple
Fireboy and Watergirl 1: The Forest Temple
author: Oslo Albet
description: Help FireBoy and WaterGirl in their adventure! Control both characters at the same time to solve platformer puzzles! Activate buttons and levers to move platforms, push boxes and roll balls, collect all the diamonds and get each character to his door!

title: Fireboy & Watergirl 2 in The Light Temple
alternateTitles: Fireboy and Watergirl 2 in The Light Temple
Fireboy and Watergirl 2: The Light Temple
author: Oslo Albet
description: Help FireBoy and WaterGirl in this new adventure! Control both characters at the same time to solve platformer puzzles! Direct light beams to the sensors using different kinds of mirrors, activate buttons and levers to move platforms, push boxes and roll balls, collect all the diamonds and get each character to his door!

title: Fireboy & Watergirl 3 in The Ice Temple
alternateTitles: Fireboy and Watergirl 3 in The Ice Temple
Fireboy and Watergirl 3: The Ice Temple
author: Oslo Albet
description: Help FireBoy and WaterGirl in this new adventure! Control both characters at the same time to solve platformer puzzles! Direct light beams to freeze and melt water, activate buttons and levers to move platforms, push boxes and roll balls, collect all the diamonds and get each character to his door!

title: Fireboy & Watergirl 4 in The Crystal Temple
alternateTitles: Fireboy and Watergirl 4 in The Crystal Temple
Fireboy and Watergirl 4: The Crystal Temple
author: Oslo Albet
description: Join Fireboy and Watergirl in this new adventure in: The Crystal Temple! In this new temple, there are crystal portals that teleport objects around.

title: Fireboy & Watergirl 5: Elements
author: Oslo Albet
developer: Oslo Albet; Jan Villanueva; Anna Tamarit
description: Explore the Elemental Temples in Fireboy and Watergirl 5 (by Oslo Albet)! Solve many puzzles, collect all the diamonds and beat the time. Fireboy and Watergirl Elements is a completely new game with lots of new elements. Travel to all temples in the Fireboy Watergirl series. Enter the new Fire Temple, The Forest Temple, The Ice Temple, The Light Temple, The Wind Temple and The Crystal Temple. In FBWG5 you can play the adventure alone or with a friend. Reach the exit safely.

title: Bad Ice Cream
author: Nitrome
description: Slide around icy mazes as an ice-cream, building and smashing walls of ice to grab all the fruit while dodging roaming enemies. Solo or two-player co-op.

title: Bad Ice Cream 2
author: Nitrome
description: The sequel — new fruit, new foes and bigger frozen mazes. Freeze paths, trap enemies and clear every board. Up to two players.

title: Bad Ice Cream 3
author: Nitrome
description: The third outing for the ice-cream duo — more fruit, more frozen mazes and new enemies to outwit. Solo or two-player co-op.

title: Earn to Die
author: Toffee Games
description: Upgrade your car and drive your way through hordes of zombies in order to reach your destination - alive.

title: Earn to Die 2012
author: Toffee Games
description: Smash through hordes of zombies as you drive your way through a zombie apocalypse, unlocking and upgrading vehicles along the way

title: Earn to Die 2012: Part 2
author: Toffee Games
description: The zombies are back! Unlock and upgrade vehicles as you drive your way through countless zombie hordes.

title: Earn to Die 2: Exodus
author: Toffee Games
description: The city has been overrun! Unlock and upgrade vehicles and drive your way through zombie hordes in order to escape

title: Snail Bob
author: Hunter Hamster
developer: Andrey Kovalishin; Maxim Yurchenko; Dmitry Petyakin
description: Lead this slimy but brave snail to his new home. Use the tools to help Bob get over this tricky building site.

title: Snail Bob 2
author: Hunter Hamster
developer: Andrey Kovalishin; Maxim Yurchenko; Dmitry Petyakin
description: A dangerous forest stands between Snail Bob and his grandpa's birthday party! You'll have to figure out how to get him there safely!

title: Snail Bob 3
author: Hunter Hamster
developer: Andrey Kovalishin; Maxim Yurchenko; Dmitry Petyakin
description: Snail Bob is back for another portal-filled adventure, this time through the tombs and traps of ancient Egypt.

title: Snail Bob 4: Space
author: Hunter Hamster
developer: Andrey Kovalishin; Maxim Yurchenko; Andrey Ivanov; Alexander Ahura / Ahuraster
description: Snail Bob is back for a fourth adventure - this time in space. Invert gravity to get the slowpoke past barriers, and try to collect all three hidden stars in each stage.

developer: Andrey Kovalishin; Maxim Yurchenko; Eugene Kisterev; Andrey Ivanov; Alexander Ahura / Ahuraster; Ytred Ned
description: Bob is in love, and now he's looking for the love of his life. Can you help him find her?

title: Snail Bob 6: Winter Story

dependencies.note: Spil SDK 1.3.1, archived alongside Fireboy & Watergirl 4. These games' own GameZIPs hold only the game.

author: Hunter Hamster
developer: Andrey Kovalishin; Maxim Yurchenko; Eugene Kisterev; Andrey Ivanov; Alexander Ahura / Ahuraster; Ytred Ned
description: Can you give Snail Bob a merry Christmas by keeping him alive? Watch out for all the obstacles along the way!

title: Snail Bob 7: Fantasy Story

dependencies.note: Spil SDK 1.3.1, archived alongside Fireboy & Watergirl 4. These games' own GameZIPs hold only the game.

author: Hunter Hamster
developer: Andrey Kovalishin; Andrey Ivanov; Alexander Ahura / Ahuraster; Maxim Yurchenko; Eugene Kisterev; Ytred Ned
description: Snail Bob comes out of his shell again, this time in a fantasy story. Try to escape, and be careful of monsters!

title: Snail Bob 8: Island Story

dependencies.note: Spil SDK 1.3.1, archived alongside Fireboy & Watergirl 4. These games' own GameZIPs hold only the game.

author: Hunter Hamster
developer: Andrey Kovalishin; Andrey Ivanov; Alexander Ahura / Ahuraster; Maxim Yurchenko; Eugene Kisterev; Ytred Ned
description: Snail Bob would love to catch some fish, or a beautiful mermaid, but instead he has been abducted and marooned on a mysterious island full of dangerous challenges. Can you get him through all 30 levels?

title: The World's Hardest Game
author: Snubby Land
description: This is The World's Hardest Game! Work your way through 30 incredibly hard levels, and if you can finish all of them you can compete for a spot on the world leader board! Also, if you think this game is hard, check out The World's Hardest Game 2!

title: The World's Hardest Game 2
author: Snubby Land
description: This is The World's Hardest Game 2! It is harder than any game you have ever played, or ever will play . Work your way through 50 incredibly hard levels and claim your spot on the world highscore board. Be sure to check out the Tips and Tricks page and also if you haven't played it yet, check out the original World's Hardest Game.

title: The World's Hardest Game 3
author: Snubby Land
description: Are you suffering from constant bouts of happiness? Lack of stress got you down? We've got just the cure for you: World's Hardest Game 3! Guaranteed to make you rage-quit or your money back! Move the red square between rooms, collect every yellow coin to unlock the exit, and press P for the map when you lose your bearings.

title: The World's Hardest Game 4
author: Snubby Land
description: See how far you can get in The World's Hardest Game 4! Can you get through mazes filled with ice, water, conveyor belts, and moving platforms? Good luck trying! There is a Hardcore Mode too, if fifty levels of the ordinary kind were not enough.

title: Henry Stickmin 1: Breaking The Bank
author: Puffballs United
description: A very funny stick movie about a poor guy who just can't get it right. Very similar to the spy vs. spy animations. How do you think our hero should Break the Bank? Laser drill, disguise, explosion, wrecking ball, teleporter, or tunnel?

title: Henry Stickmin 2: Escaping The Prison
author: Puffballs United
description: Here it is, the sequel to Breaking the Bank! This one's a little different from it's predecessor however. You can actually win! There are three different victorious endings to this game. You can escape the Lame Way, the Sneaky Way, or the Badass Way. See if you can find them all!

title: Henry Stickmin 3: Stealing The Diamond
author: Puffballs United
description: You've successfully Escaped the Prison; now it's time to make some cash by Stealing the Diamond!

title: Henry Stickmin 4: Infiltrating The Airship
author: Puffballs United
description: Now that you've Stolen the Diamond it's time to Infiltrate the Airship!

title: Henry Stickmin 5: Fleeing The Complex
author: Puffballs United
description: Henry has Broken the bank, escaped the prison, stolen the diamond and infiltrated the airship. Perhaps the complex known as "The Wall" can hold Henry the Stickman in his biggest adventure yet!

title: The Fancy Pants Adventure: World 1
author: Brad Borne
developer: Brad Borne / Borne Games / DrNeroCF; Geier Arnold / -API- / apimusic
description: The first world in the Fancy Pants Adventures series. Don’t forget to play World 2 next!

title: The Fancy Pants Adventures: World 2
author: Brad Borne
description: Fancy Pants returns with a fresh adventure. Select your fanciest pants and get ready for World 2!

title: The Fancy Pants Adventures: World 3
author: Brad Borne
description: The third World, and the largest of the Flash entries — new moves, new enemies and a great deal more Squiggleville to run through.

title: The Fancy Pants Adventures: World 4 Part 1
author: Brad Borne
description: A week-long rain has left Squiggleville in ruin and a mysterious volcano looms in the distance. What is a mere stickman to do when half of his home has been washed away?

title: The Fancy Pants Adventures: World 4 Part 2
author: Brad Borne
description: Onward — Fancy Pants Man continues his fourth adventure. The rain has cleared, but Squiggleville remains a runny shadow of its former self. And you are keeping an eye on that volcano, right?

title: The Fancy Pants Adventures: World 4 Part 3
author: Brad Borne
description: World 4 is the online release of Super Fancy Pants Adventure, split into parts because it is a big game. This is the third.

title: The Fancy Pants Adventures: World 1 Remix!
author: Brad Borne
description: World 1, remixed: the original levels rebuilt with the later engine, new routes and a gamepad-friendly control scheme. This is Borne Games' earlier self-contained build — the newer one calls a MochiAds service that Ruffle refuses to load, and stalls on its splash.

title: The Cutie Pants Adventures: World 1
author: Brad Borne
description: Revisit a classic with a cuter twist — World 1 played as Cutie Pants rather than Fancy Pants Man.

title: Fancy Box
author: Brad Borne
description: A level-building sandbox for the Fancy Pants engine. Click inside to start, [S] to jump, arrow keys to move, and Shift to turn off the level skeleton.

title: Fancy Snowboarding
author: Brad Borne
description: Fancy Pants Man takes to a snowboard. A short, mouse-only spin-off from the platformers.

title: Bad Piggies v2.0
author: Rovio
description:
Rovio's pigs get their own game: build a contraption out of crates, wheels and engines and drive it to the goal without falling apart. 
Note: the one from archive are v2.0, the one from flashpoint is v1.0.

title: City Under Siege
author: FreeOnlineGames
description: Defend your city at all costs in this Battle City-Type game on massive steroids, City Under Siege!

title: Bloxorz
author: Damien Clarke
description: Get the block to fall into the square hole.

title: Motherload
author: XGen Studios
description: Motherload!

title: Effing Worms
author: Effing Games
developer: Bobby Graeber; Bogdan Ene; Symphony of S.; Sam Hyde
description: Eat shitloads of stick figures playing as gigantic worm. Maybe if you eat enough people, you’ll grow up to be big and fat like daddy worm. See how big you can become.

title: Interactive Buddy
author: Shock Value
description: A physics sandbox where you can interact with a ragdoll character in various ways, using different tools and objects to manipulate it. The game allows for creative experimentation and has a variety of modes and settings to explore.

title: The Insanity Box
author: poxpower
description:
DON'T PRESS TAB, EVER!
A hundred short, hostile minigames back to back, each with its own controls and its own way of killing you. Save points at 25, 50 and 75.

title: The Insanity Box 2
author: poxpower
description: Thirty new minigames in story, random or practice mode. Each one explains itself, briefly, and then does its best to end your run.
